svg.title: TabFM - classifier
svg.desc: Google - column and row stages run twice, then an in-context stack · 1.64 B parameters. Abbreviations: ICL: in-context learning: test rows attend to the labelled training rows; CLS: learned summary token that reads out a row or column; MLP: multilayer perceptron (the feed-forward sublayer); SwiGLU: gated linear unit with a Swish activation; RMSNorm: root-mean-square normalisation; KV: keys and values (as in KV cache, KV heads). How to read: three bands: the phases, then the stages in them, then each stage's sublayers summed over all of its stacked blocks; width: parameters, on one linear scale for the whole figure; a stage with no listed sublayers fills its own width in the sublayer band; embedding / encoder (its sublayers in a muted shade); attention (its sublayers in a muted shade); feed-forward (its sublayers in a muted shade); normalisation (its sublayers in a muted shade); decoder head (its sublayers in a muted shade); stages with no parameters (the input, a weightless embedding, the prediction) have no width and are not drawn.
